# `AudioRedirectionMode`

Sets and retrieves the audio redirection mode and different audio redirection options.


## Type

```csharp
RoyalApps.Community.FreeRdp.WinForms.Configuration.AudioRedirectionMode
```

## Used By

- [FreeRdpConfiguration](/api/reference/royalapps-community-freerdp-winforms-configuration-freerdpconfiguration)

[View source](https://github.com/royalapplications/royalapps-community-freerdp/blob/main/src/RoyalApps.Community.FreeRdp.WinForms/Configuration/AudioRedirectionMode.cs#L6)

## Values

### `NotSpecified = -1`


Audio redirection is not specified. The default value of wfreerdp.exe is used.


### `Local = 0`


Audio redirection is enabled, and the option for redirection is "Bring to this computer".


### `Server = 1`


Audio redirection is enabled and the option is "Leave at remote computer".


### `None = 2`


Audio redirection is enabled and the mode is "Do not play".
